projects.name: mini-hypervisor
projects.blocker: Open implementation PR #94 owns the current virtio-blk interrupt milestone; recheck source head, PR state and exact-head CI after it resolves.
projects.integration_notes: Potential future edge to minios-x86 requires a deterministic bootable guest artifact and machine-observable guest milestone; no compatibility claim exists yet.

projects.name: minios-x86
projects.blocker: Open implementation PR #35 owns concurrent child-wait correctness work; do not freeze the source while that implementation is active.
projects.integration_notes: Potential future guest for mini-hypervisor and consumer of explicitly specified filesystem/network boundaries; no such umbrella edge is currently verified.

projects.name: filesystem-lab
projects.repository_hygiene_notes: Frozen source contains Cargo metadata, README, docs, Rust source, tests and CI configuration. No top-level LICENSE file, nested repository, vendored cache or generated binary payload was observed; preserve that source state rather than inventing metadata.
projects.attribution_notes: Configured reachable-history commit-message searches returned no disallowed attribution matches before selection. Re-run the scan immediately before the actual import if source main moves.
projects.integration_notes: Do not claim minios-x86 integration until both sides share an explicit image/format/replay contract with executable tests.

projects.name: userspace-tcpip-stack
projects.blocker: Open implementation PR #330 owns PTP transparent-clock correctness work; recheck the resulting source checkpoint before migration.
projects.integration_notes: Possible TAP/TUN, namespace, or packet-fixture integrations must be bounded and executable. The userspace stack is not assumed to be a minios-x86 network stack or Linux kernel replacement.

projects.name: mini-container-runtime
projects.blocker: Open implementation PR #392 is still integrating OCI process defaults into public run admission; wait for that implementation checkpoint before freezing the source.
projects.integration_notes: This remains a Linux-host subsystem based on namespaces/cgroups/process primitives. It is not placed under minios-x86 in the architecture graph.
